findings.contract: Request/peer workflows retain task ownership across exceptional exits.
findings.evidence: Raw spawned response peers and upgrade transactions are normally awaited only after fallible operations and assertions. The parent absolute timeout drops the workflow without aborting those child JoinHandles. The source establishes detachment semantics, not an executed resource-leak result.
findings.remedy: Join compatible peer/request branches lexically or introduce an H1-domain owner only where actual concurrent driver consumers require it. Preserve wire, typed limit, discard, upgrade and subscriber assertions.
findings.verification_required: Actual accepted/driven exchange readiness followed by workflow cancellation with runtime and client endpoint retained, typed peer failure propagation, and unchanged success positives on both native hosts.

findings.contract: The H2 WebSocket echo handler remains owned when the outer origin future exits.
findings.evidence: serve_h2_echo raw handler at line58 remains detached when the outer future is cancelled or returns from the unexpected-stream/protocol-error branches. Handler completion additionally ignores all body errors and capacity/end-stream send results.
findings.remedy: Retain an abort-on-drop or lexical domain handler owner, preserve typed unrelated failures, and classify only explicitly expected Close teardown.
findings.verification_required: Real extended CONNECT response and echo readiness, cancellation with client/runtime retained, original non-CANCEL error control and existing Close success oracles.

bounded_no_findings: Response-head shared state has a transaction reset and synchronous poll-only lock scope. Buffer/count limits and ordered names/casing remain bounded. Existing backend cap/caller traces prevent treating non-interim observer failure as a new hanging-stream defect.

Capsule header indexing follows private width invariants. DATAGRAM allocation is bounded before conversion; unknown values skip without payload buffering. Existing encode/decode round trips are property evidence, not independently literal wire conformance.
Existing adjacent response-limit impl blocks have a coherent small responsibility; no size-only or paragraph-only restructuring is justified. Authorized earlier narrow grouping changes are preserved.
